headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2024: Serena Deeb returned to the fold after just over 2 months away, appearing on Dynamite.
On this day in 2024, Chris Jericho vs. Katsuyori Shibata went to battle over the FTW Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.66. A hard-fought battle for the gold.
Rewind to 2024, when Brian Cage was back in action after just under 2 months away, appearing on Dynamite.

secondaries.text: 2024 brought us this moment: Adam Copeland vs. Buddy Matthews put the AEW TNT Title on the line, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.64.
